name: heliograph
description: Run commands on a machine you cannot SSH into.
long_description: Publishes a step to a transport the far side already reaches - git, a file share, S3-compatible storage, a relay, or a file carried by hand - and the whole run comes back as a log with every line timestamped in UTC, whether it passed or failed. For air-gapped, bastion-only and change-controlled estates. No tunnel, no proxy, nothing held open. The gates live on the far side: a tool call can ask, but cannot authorise.
